hook: Iran says US warships *won't enter the Persian Gulf* and threatens war if attacked again
tldr: Iran's Revolutionary Guards warned of an 'apocalyptic war' that would 'decide the fate' of Gulf nations if the US and Israel strike again, amid reports Washington is considering new air strikes.

beats.what: IRGC spokesperson Brig. Gen. Hossein Mohebbi warned that any US–Israeli attack would have consequences beyond Iran. Armed forces chief Maj. Gen. Ali Abdollahi said US naval forces can no longer approach the Gulf.
beats.why: Reports say the US is weighing a fresh round of strikes. In earlier phases of the war, Iran hit US bases and energy facilities in Gulf kingdoms.
beats.care: The Gulf is where most of India's oil comes from and where lakhs of Indians work. Any escalation can push up petrol prices and worry families with someone there.

cards.body: The US aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln arrived at San Diego on Oct 8. Iran's statement says the Gulf monarchies would be part of any war.

opts: US bases and Gulf energy facilities

learn.t: About a fifth of the world's oil passes through the Strait of Hormuz, the narrow mouth of the Persian Gulf.
